key.name: workspaces-root
key.description: Directory holding the workspace tree. Empty means the default, $HOME/Workspaces.

key.name: projects-root
key.description: Directory suggested first when picking a working directory or repository for a folder. Empty means the default, $HOME/projects.

key.name: default-backend
key.description: Backend used when no folder in the chain specifies one.

key.name: expanded-folders
key.summary: Folders left open in the sidebar
key.description: Folder ids (from each folder's .hy.json) that were expanded when the window was last used, so the tree comes back the way it was left.
